response.overview: # Translation  Amzar and Alina's first meeting is merely a result of misunderstanding. Alina, who doesn't want to be labelled a 'loser' for still being single at her thirties, quickly grabs Amzar's arm, who happens to be there, to introduce him as her fiancé to avoid becoming the target of ridicule from Zufa, her arch-enemy since their school days. Amzar's life becomes chaotic after this sudden engagement story breaks out. As if it was meant to be, after that incident they meet again at Alina's workplace and Amzar is introduced as her new boss. Amzar uses the opportunity to get revenge on Alina for hurting his feelings, resulting in Alina being fired under the pretext of reducing the company's financial burden. Alina's meeting with Zafril, Amzar's brother, takes the story of Amzar and Alina to another phase. From hatred to the opposite. Feelings of love begin to blossom but suddenly there is interference from Hairi, Alina's ex-boyfriend who once inflicted emotional wounds on her.
response.title: Dia Random Guy
